_comment: Retired model ids and enabledModels patterns pruned from the installed ~/.pi/agent config by scripts/merge_pi_agent_config.py. Listed entries are removed from models.json (by id and by modelOverrides key) and from settings.json enabledModels. Every unlisted local-only provider, model, override and pattern is preserved. Removing the 'MunitoAI/*' glob (SA-0MWL5AL4B004X0FN) is why operators stop seeing 'No models match pattern' warnings; to restore paid MunitoAI models deliberately, drop the entry from retiredEnabledModels and re-run scripts/install_pi.sh.
